sections.title: Hear From Our Teachers
sections.subtitle: Discover how Kidato has helped educators across Africa pursue their passion for teaching.

testimonials.name: Grace Muthoni
testimonials.content: Joining Kidato has transformed my teaching career. I can now reach students across Africa while earning a reliable income on my own schedule.

testimonials.name: Daniel Okonkwo
testimonials.content: As a teacher on Kidato, I've found a supportive community that values quality education. The platform is intuitive and the students are motivated to learn.

testimonials.name: Fatima Abdullahi
testimonials.content: The flexibility Kidato offers has allowed me to balance my passion for teaching with my family responsibilities. It's truly the best of both worlds.
